in_text_mentions: e years. She reported no limitations in activities of daily living, although her walking distance remained limited. Her last visit to an orthopedic surgeon was six years ago. Radiographs obtained at that time showed lucency (Figures 1-3). However, the patient was asymptomatic; therefore, no further follow-up was planned. Over the subsequent two years, she developed progressively worsening symptoms in both knees and presented to our institution with near inability to walk and continuous pain. To maintain some level of fitness, the patient cycled for about 30 minutes per day on an exercise bike.
